messages.subject: PTT Global Chemical | Low-carbon industry, ESG governance and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear PTT Global Chemical Sustainability and Executive Leadership Team,

GC's direction around high-value, low-carbon businesses and its Map Ta Phut industrial platform is closely aligned with the work I have been leading across ESG, energy transition and institutional engagement.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy across a large resource operation.

My experience is strongest where sustainability must withstand operating scrutiny. I have supported governance and external engagement around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, and coordinated carbon-data readiness using physical records across fuel, electricity, explosives, materials, production and refinery datasets. I also manage regulator interfaces, community priorities and cross-functional corrective actions.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand, ASEAN or regional roles across Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Strategic Partnerships, Government Relations or responsible business. I have attached a GC-focused executive CV showing how this experience could support the company's low-carbon growth agenda.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
